content: I'm {{Sohaib Mokhliss}} — an {{engineer in Computer & Network Engineering}} (EMSI) and a {{Specialized Technician in Cybersecurity}} (ISTA).
Two diplomas, one thread: I build applications and systems that combine {{clean architecture}}, {{automation}}, and {{strong security principles}}.
You can download my CV from the button below.
I hold {{two diplomas}}: an {{engineering degree in Computer & Network Engineering}} from EMSI, and a {{Specialized Technician diploma in Cybersecurity}} from ISTA.
I gained hands-on experience through internships at {{HPS}}, {{CIH}}, {{ITPay}}, and {{BMCE}}.
My path started with {{security assessment}} and {{penetration testing}}, then grew into {{application development}}, {{CI/CD}}, and platform-oriented engineering.
Current focus: {{full-stack development}}, {{backend systems}}, {{CI/CD automation}}, and the day-to-day work required to keep platforms {{reliable}}, {{repeatable}}, and {{secure}}.
I especially enjoy working across {{product development}}, {{Linux environments}}, and container-based infrastructure without losing sight of secure design.
{{I am looking for a pre-hire internship (stage pré-embauche) or a full-time position}}, and I can start immediately.
You can connect with me on LinkedIn or review my work on GitHub.
For a {{pre-hire internship}}, a {{full-time role}}, or freelance work, reach me at sohaibmokhliss@gmail.com.
